headline: Zhipu AI's flash model hits 13.8% — day 2 of dominance
summary: Zhipu AI's glm-5.3-flash continues its ascent, now commanding 13.8% of tokens and holding the top spot for a second straight day. DeepSeek remains firmly in second at 11.1%, while OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna slips to third with 9.1%. Two new models entered the rankings today: Anthropic's claude-5-fable and Google's gemini-3.6-flash, while Qwen's flash variants dropped out.
highlights: Zhipu AI surges to 17.8% provider share (+2.8% today), now the second-largest by volume after DeepSeek's 19.7%
glm-5.3-flash-20260826 sets an all-time token-share record at 13.8%, extending its streak to day 2
OpenAI's gpt-5.6-sol jumps 5 ranks to #15 (+0.5% share); gpt-5.6-terra climbs 7 spots to #28
MiniMax's free tier drops 5 ranks to #10 (-2.5% share in one day); Xiaomi's mimo-v2.5 slides 2 spots to #8
Anthropic gains ground overall (+1.5% provider share), with claude-opus-5 and claude-sonnet-5 both climbing into the top 20
Market concentration (HHI) ticked up 0.9 points to 0.115, reflecting Zhipu's consolidation at the top
